title: Rent a Paddle Board And Float the Lower Salt River
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
** Self Guided Paddle Board Trip**
** One Vehicle needed, Transportation not included **
** Please Read What to Expect Section **

If you don't want to be herded like cattle you've come to the right outfitter. We are the most affordable option for experiencing the Lower Salt River and you get to enjoy it on your time not on a strict tour operator schedule. We have helped thousands enjoy the Lower Salt River.

On arrival to our shop, one of our staff members set you up to float to Salt River like a local. There is plenty of wildlife to see including wild horses, river otters, and big horn sheep. Enjoy multiple resting spots on the river to enjoy a nice swim. The river is class one river, known to be beginner friendly. We have all the knowledge, equipment, and tools to help you get out on the water for a successful self guided trip.

We will go over a map with you in the front office to custom tailor a route that best suites your groups desires - trip routes range from 1 - 5 hrs.
